deliberateDepartures: The common light palette replaces the example warm palette and serif lettering, as required.
Paper rotations are reduced to 1.5–2 degrees and Japanese text remains upright for target-size readability.
The reference composition pattern and export icon are omitted because they would introduce unrelated objects. Hand-authored chair, clock, check and box cutouts adapt the supplied kit construction.
Long role labels use deliberate line breaks without abbreviation.
The common surface is pure white; border-colored offset shadows and sheet top strips provide layer separation without a new background color.
